invariants.title: Nobody is in the frame
invariants.rule: The shot is the place alone.
invariants.why: an empty shot that grows a person is a different shot

invariants.title: The place is back-alley
invariants.rule: The background is the back-alley plate night_wide__angleu75 and stays that place for the whole take.
invariants.why: words that name what the plate lacks make the engine rewrite it

invariants.title: Angle: worm's eye
invariants.rule: The place is seen from worm's eye. The plate is warped by the studio before the engine sees it - the camera drops and tilts, with the parallax taken from the depth map.
invariants.why: an engine treats an angle word as a suggestion; a plate is what it copies

invariants.title: Camera: static
invariants.rule: The camera does not move - the engine is asked to hold still and the move is done by the studio after the render, then measured.
invariants.why: an engine cannot be asked for a camera move (measured: a locked-off sentence still pushed in 3 of 3); arithmetic can

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: resolution and length trade inside a fixed envelope
